message.content:
Here’s a quick mix of classic, modern, psychological, supernatural, and slasher horror films that have earned a reputation for being genuinely scary (or at least entertainingly frightening). Feel free to pick based on your taste—whether you prefer gore, atmosphere, or mind‑bending twists.

| # | Title | Year | Subgenre / Notable Element |
|---|-------|------|----------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Psychological horror; iconic haunted hotel setting. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Family trauma + supernatural dread; intense atmosphere. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social satire meets horror; clever twist. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Silence as survival; tense sound design. |
| 5 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Creepy “invisible” stalker; retro vibe. |
| 6 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror; unsettling folk rituals. |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal investigation; jump‑scare heavy. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological monster; metaphorical depth. |
| 9 | **Saw** | 2004 | Survival game; moral dilemmas & gore. |
|10 | **Halloween** | 1978 | Classic slasher; Michael Myers’ silent menace. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Viral curse; creepy videotape. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found‑footage realism; subtle terror. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑horror; subverts tropes. |
|14 | **Suspiria** (2018) | 2018 | Visually striking; supernatural dance troupe. |
|15 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Puritan horror; slow‑burn dread. |

If you’re looking for something more niche or a particular style (e.g., Japanese J‑Horror, found footage, or creature features), let me know and I can tailor the list further!
